description: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management (ABV-IIITM) is an autonomous Institute of National Importance in Gwalior, founded by the Government of India in 1997, focused on integrated information technology and management education.

agent_notes: Normal TLS requests returned the exact managed-proxy error 'SSL certificate problem: self signed certificate in certificate chain'; public GET requests were retried with curl --insecure after confirming the expected search and official hosts.

The current official homepage's 'Choose your Course & Learning' section and Offerings navigation enumerate the active programme catalogue. Legacy /all-academic and /course-learning.php routes returned the official site's 404 page and were not used as catalogue evidence.
The M.Tech page explicitly lists six current specialization programme names; those are represented as separate course records using the shared official M.Tech page.
The Integrated Post Graduate page explicitly presents the IMT and IMG tracks; they are represented as separate course records using the shared official page.
